_comment: Reference snippet -- merge this entry into the stdio-proxy servers.json that hosts the Azure DevOps MCP (e.g. mcps/stdio-proxy/servers.windows-work.json). Kept here so the MCP's launch args live next to its docker-compose overlay. Deliberately unpinned; note this package has the heaviest native-dependency surface of the hosted MCPs -- it reaches keytar via @azure/msal-node-extensions, which dlopens libsecret-1.so.0. The stdio-proxy Dockerfile installs libsecret for exactly this reason; do not drop it.
